- Must-haves: SSO, audit logs, KV cache isolation, predictable tail latency at 99th pct.

3) a short performance profile for a 2.5k token chat workload (expected p95/p99 on a mid-tier Dedicated node).

Markus — can you review the SOC checklist and be prepared to address any compliance questions (audit logs retention, KMS integration, data residency) on Thu? If procurement wants a separate conversation we can schedule a 20-minute follow-up the same week.

Procurement team — per Alicia’s note, happy to share a short commercial summary. Quick draft below:
- Reserved capacity: committed monthly node-hours, tiered discounts at >3-month commit
- Typical timeline: PO -> onboarding (2–3 weeks) -> pilot -> scale

I’ll send a calendar invite once Rishi confirms readiness and Markus confirms availability.

Thanks all —
